name: Pixel Flaps
hook: Pass off generative couture to snooty magazine editors before pixels blur
tagline: Inspect luxury quilted handbags and designer pumps under high-magnification loupes as the multiplier rises. Cash out to publish the spread and collect the commission before anyone notices the crooked stitching. Crash when the pixel detector pings red, spawning seven-fingered runway disaster graphics across the newsroom.
